fact: The Ministry's Deeds Registry page says that since 1995 the Registry has done away with manual land, debts and miscellaneous contract registers because the information is computerised and retrievable within seconds, with registers updated daily.

Registrar of Deeds Nozipho Vilakati said Eswatini is working to upgrade its manual registration and storage of deeds into a fully electronic system, after benchmarking visits to Kenya's Ardhisasa platform.
